Frequently asked questions

Can you measure a campaign that has no conversion link?

Yes. We measure what the campaign moved in the conversation: volume, tone, themes, and above all which audiences changed their position. That often says more than a click-through rate.

Do you need to know before the launch?

It helps to set the baseline, but it is not required: the conversation is public and archived, so we can rebuild the before after the fact.

Which platforms do you cover?

Social networks (TikTok, Instagram, X, LinkedIn, YouTube, Facebook), online press, forums and reviews, search, and the answers of generative AI.
